Suggestion and amount chips: approved BaselinePill presentation with Figma padding/gaps; all three amounts visible.
Portfolio: 217px basket cards, original bold titles, 12px performance caption, 82px product rows in basket detail; card/dot/holding selection preserved.
Product documents: holding details open from basket detail as well as carousel; KID affordance opens executable demo document preview.

Contract: shared BaselineBottomSheet gains optional padding/contentBleed; 24px header/footer insets, edge-to-edge document area and sticky actions; defaults unchanged.
Signing: title inset24; PIN label measured at logical y281 = Figma y247 plus modern safe-area delta34; other signing defaults unchanged.

Success/error: source artwork dimensions, body emphasis/spacing, canonical actions and header affordances; draft-preserving retry unchanged.
